title: Structurally sound Horn rule-gate and learned frontier progress

parent.AF14_scientific_result: local failed, hosted blocked prior to runner assignment
parent.frozen_cell: Original source-hash-verified TypedLoop in AF-02 import; no prior AF14 weights or source modifications

mathematics.state: Host-owned set S of currently proved atoms, initialized to public source facts
mathematics.allowed_rule: A public Horn rule P -> h is selectable exactly when P subset S and h absent S
mathematics.transition: Host atomically adds only the chosen enabled head h; STOP adds nothing and terminates
mathematics.invariant: At every state S_0 subset S_t subset S_inf (least Horn closure), and S_t subset S_(t+1)
mathematics.proof_credit: Every accepted rule action has source-bound physical rule slot, premise list, head and observed known state; only proved G earns success
mathematics.completion_limit: Safety is structural. Eventual completion requires fair or goal-directed rule choice; a trained rule ranker can stop early
mathematics.training_oracle: Deterministic shortest-path dynamic programming for minimum number of single-rule firing actions to derive G; target set includes all optimal legal rule firings
mathematics.frontier_loss: Imitation CE of mass on any optimal allowed action, plus 0.5 mean softplus(0.35 - optimal_rule_logit + nonoptimal_legal_logit) on source states with both action classes

data.novelty: Heldout has new physical graph layouts 32-37, with same AF-05 Horn AND/OR rule templates and fact patterns
data.model_input: Public graph incidence, initial facts, current host-owned proved atoms, role marks and public rule metadata; host legality mask; no goal truth, optimal path or proof-distance labels
data.split_guard: Commit exact feature hash manifest and data-generating source before training; dev is qualification only; heldout scoring only after fixed checkpoint publication

model.architecture: 6->16 atom embed (initial features + current fact bit), 3->16 rule embed, 2 shared typed recurrence calls, linear rule scores and linear goal-dependent STOP score
model.gradient_target: Original TypedLoop cell, input embeddings and rule/stop heads

training.init: Identical per-seed model parameters and sampler for arms; fixed final checkpoint; all .pt and matching named .npz arrays retained
training.comparison: Same native forward calls and optimizer updates; frontier extra loss and backward arithmetic not exactly FLOP-matched
training.fitting: Train only, save train/dev goal-proving rates before heldout scoring

evaluation.rule_budget: For a provable goal, minimum number of sound Horn rule fires plus exactly one extra action. For unprovable goals, at most two actions and safe abstention
evaluation.eligibility: Both trained arms must meet >=0.80 proof success on training and >=0.75 on development, separately by seed
evaluation.primary_gate: For every eligible seed, frontier minus imitation proof success >=0.05 on both fresh held depths4/5, frontier absolute success >=0.80, false host proof acceptance zero, frontier no worse than fixed rule-order control by >0.03. Eligible failure yields aggregate FAIL, otherwise full seed passes yield PASS, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluation.independent_integrity: Reconstruct each physical Horn edge directly from committed public incidence, verify every action and proof trace, exact optimal-action budgets, raw scores, Torch/NumPy weights and sampled forward predictions. Reject rehashed mutated evidence.
evaluation.proof_scope: This is neuro-symbolic rule scheduling with a host legal-action gate. It is not independent neural theorem proving; structural correctness is supplied by the external Horn semantics.

formal: Lean 4.19.0 checks abstract Boolean sound/inflation laws; Python oracle traces and heldout model scores are separate
failure_policy: Retain every seed and negative result; engineering CI success is separate from scientific outcome. No source or threshold tuning based on heldouts; changes require AF-16.
